sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification as of the latest record (2026-10-02). No newer document lifts it, so it may not receive new parts or new business now. Moving BR-180 delivery to Pinerolo is a new supply arrangement.

sources.quote: Temporary permit to accept BR-180 brackets from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C)

findings.why: No controlled record gives Chisone a current approval for BR-180 at Pinerolo (PLT-PIN) for the customer. The only BR-180 document is DEV-114, which is expired. It was a deviation for Beinasco, not a source release. Absence of a record is not proof that the source is not approved, so someone must confirm. The customer is inferred from DEV-114's Aurelia approval, because no document links the part to a customer.
